title: Cholecystectomy | Gallbladder Removal with da Vinci:registered:
description: Facing gallbladder surgery? Learn about virtually scarless surgery with minimally invasive da Vinci:registered: Single-Site:registered: robotic assisted surgery with Fall General Surgery, in Ashland, WI and Duluth, MN.  If you have gallbladder disease and your symptoms get worse, your doctor may suggest surgery. Surgery to take out your gallbladder is called a cholecystectomy. It can be done with open surgery or minimally invasive surgery.  Open Surgery: With open surgery, your gallbladder is removed through an open incision (cut). The incision must be large enough for your surgeon’s hands and instruments to fit inside your body and reach your organs.  Minimally Invasive Surgery: During traditional laparoscopy, your surgeon operates through either a few small incisions in your abdomen or one small incision in your belly button. Long instruments are used to reach your gallbladder. One of the instruments is a tiny camera that sends images to a video screen to guide surgeons as they operate.   Dr. Fall is a board certified general surgeon who has been treating varicose vein disease and venous hypertension for 25 years. He is current with the latest techniques and technology that is available on the market for treating vein patients. We are able to treat the unsightly spider veins, the symptomatic surface veins and veins above the muscles that are refluxing and no longer functioning to help venous return. The staff at Fall General Surgery is also trained on office based evaluation, pre-authorization and the modern treatments of varicose veins.  Serving the Duluth and Ashland areas YourNorthlandVeinCenter.com is the leader in this procedure. Call to schedule your appointment today! [PHONE]  Visit our website at: http://www.yournorthlandveincenter.com Please follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fallgeneralsurgery YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/fallgeneralsurgery

asr.full_text: Hello, my name is George Fall, I'm a general surgeon with Fall General Surgery in Ashland, Wisconsin and Duluth, Minnesota. I'm a board-certified general surgeon and a fellow of the American College of Surgery's. I've been practicing for 23 years. I want you to come visit us at fallgenmals Surgery. I've been practicing for 23 years. I want you to come visit us at fallgenitalsurgery.com and please enjoy the video. If you're facing gallbladder surgery ask about all types of surgery available including minimally invasive surgery through one belly button incision using traditional laparoscopy, or Robotically assisted da Vinci surgery. Using da Vinci, and its single site technology, doctors have a 3d HD view inside your body, and operate with precise movements. To perform this procedure, your surgeon first gently clamps the gallbladder, then the cystic duct is carefully cut. Next the gallbladder is freed from the liver, and finally it is removed from your body. The end result, virtually scar-free surgery.
